component.name: zark
component.summary: See the state of your zark backups and backup drives

description.p: zark backs up and recovers Ubuntu systems installed on encrypted ZFS. This app shows how its backups stand: how full the system pools are, each backup drive with its last backup, its space and its backup points by month, the datasets left out of backups, and a backup running in a terminal, with its progress.
It runs zark's operations: each is one zark command, run with the administrator's password through pkexec, in a terminal inside the window where zark asks its questions as it always does.
Fixes: the page keeps its place when the window redraws, the progress shows a percentage of the data only, backup points show local time, and a drive mounted for browsing offers Open and Unmount.
Operations: back up, reclaim space, prepare, check, erase and register drives, exclusions and retention, each run by zark in a terminal inside the window.
The first version: the state of zark's backups, read-only, for zark 2.3.0 and later.
